name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A private, self-owned alternative to Notion and Miro that brings notes, planning, and diagramming into one app you fully control.
buyer: A privacy-conscious professional or small team that wants Notion-like planning tools without their data living on someone else's cloud servers.
business_use_cases: A law firm or healthcare practice adopts it as their internal planning tool because it can be self-hosted and keeps client data in-house.
A small agency replaces paid Notion and Miro seats with a self-hosted instance to cut recurring software costs.
A privacy-focused startup offers managed hosting of it as a 'private Notion' product for other privacy-conscious businesses.

money_ideas.idea: Offer managed, supported self-hosting of it for businesses that want the privacy but not the server maintenance.
Sell migration services helping teams move off Notion/Miro onto a self-hosted instance.

steal_this: Set up and brand a managed-hosting offering of it this weekend, aimed squarely at privacy-sensitive small firms (law, health, finance) tired of Notion.
